tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bla ma rgyang 'bod dang gsol 'debs skor bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/sdom gsum bka' drin stsol ba'i drin can gyi bla ma/ /skyabs gnas mchog gas

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma rgyang 'bod dang gsol 'debs skor bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ sdom gsum bka' drin stsol ba'i drin can gyi bla ma/ /skyabs gnas mchog gsum 'dus pa skyabs kun gyi ngo bo/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag tu bzhugs pa'i/ /mtshungs med drin chen bla ma snying dbus nas dran no/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pas 'khor ba la mi gnas/ /dmigs med lhag bsam 'byongs pas zhi ba la ma chags/ /zung 'jug rgyal sras spyod pas snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba/ /thar pa'i gling du 'dren pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i srog rtsa rdol ba las byung ba'i/ /kun btags 'khor ba'i khrag mtsho srid rtse ru 'phyur ba/ /rang bzhin stong pa'i zhal du hub gcig gis gsol ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jam mgon bla ma de mkhyen no/ /gsal ba snying rje'i rang gzugs zhi ba yi lha tshogs/ /stong pa dbyings kyi rang mdangs khro tshogs su shar ba/ zung 'jug 'khor lo'i mgon po rigs kun gyi bdag po/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i ded dpon bla ma de mkhyen no/ /phyi nang 'khrul pa'i rdzun ris rang sems su bsdu zhing / /rang snang rtsa rlung thig le lha sku ru sbyangs nas/ /gang snang dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu shar ba/ /mtshungs med grub pa'i dbang phyug bla ma de mkhyen no/ /ro rkyang 'khor ba'i lam du las rlung gis bskul ba'i/ /gzung 'dzin nyi zla'i rgyu ba skad cig la bcad de/ sgra gcan dbu ma'i lto bar yud tsam la 'debs pa/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug bla ma de mkhyen no/ /'khrul snang yan par shor ba'i rgyud gsum gyi dregs pa/ /rang sems dag pa'i snang ngor sku gsum gyi lha tshogs/ /rang ngo legs par 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis/ /rang snang dbang du 'dus pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /nam yang 'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus kyi ngang nas/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba rang 'debs na/

/sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis mngon sum du gzigs nas/ /dgongs pa dbyer med 'gyur ba byin gyis rang rlobs shig /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba dug bzhin du spangs nas/ /rtag tu dben pa'i ri la gcig pu ru gnas te/ /yengs med sgrub la brtson pa'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis/ /na dga' shi skyid 'byung ba'i skal bzang la smon no/ /'dir snang che dgu'i zhal 'dzum thob pa rang med kyang / /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhal lung snying dbus su bcangs nas/ /chos brgyad rdul du gzhig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi ngang nas/ /'jigs med btsan sa zin pa'i smon lam zhig zhu'o/ /zhes pa'ang mi nyag ka bzhi la thog tu kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis smras pa dge/ ༈ /rje rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ngag gi dbang phyug chos kyi rje/ /pha 'jam mgon legs pa'i mtshan can la/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su mchi/ /mgon khyed kyi gsang gsum byin rlabs rnams/ /bu bdag gi rgyud la zhugs nas ni/ /thugs dbyer med byang chub ma thob bar/ /dus 'bral ba med par bskyab tu gsol/ /bdag sngon byas las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /yul mdo smad phyogs su skyes na yang / /tshe sngon gyi byed pa mthu btsan pas/ /skyabs sku drin mtshungs med khyed dang 'phrad/ /thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung nas ni/ /chos zab dgu'i gdams pa bdag la gnang / /sngon las kyi 'brel ba'i yi dam la/ /sems gus pas gsol ba thob cig dang / /khyod rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes/ /rje khyed kyis bdag la lung bstan mdzad/ /tshul de bzhin nyams su len ba'i tshe/ /spyir las ngan dus su smin pa dang / /sgos sdig pa'i grogs kyi rkyen dbang gis/ /bzod shin tu dka' ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /dus rgyun chad med par mnar na yang / /skyabs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /yid rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /sems bde ba'i ngal bso cung zad thob/

/nyams rtogs pa bdag la ma mchis kyang / /ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi bcud/ /rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhal gyi chab/ /dpal brtse ba chen po'i ring lugs la/ /blo yid ches kyi dad pa cung zad skyes/ /chos zab par grags pa phal cher la/ /da kho bo 'gram chu mi ldang bar/ /mi dbul pos nor bu rnyed pa ltar/ /sems tshim par gyur to chos kyi rje/ /da re zhig dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /las chags sdang gi bya ba spangs nas ni/ /nga sdod pa'i dam bca' bgyis gyur na/ /pha khyed kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs lags sam/ /gnas ngo mtshar ri khrod dgon pa ru/ /skyabs mtshan ldan bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /chos byang chub sems la blo sbyangs nas/ /bdag gnas pa'i dus shig nam 'ong na/ /gzhi dam tshig sdom pa srog ltar srung / /lam rim gnyis rgyun chad med par bsgom/ /nyams rtogs pa'i rtsal kha rab tu 'bar/ /sems skyid pa'i dus shig nam 'ong na/ /gzhi ma dag 'khor ba lcags kyi khams/ /lam smin grol gnyis kyi 'gyur rtsi yis/ /gnas yongs gyur 'bras bu'i gser bzang po/ /ngas mthong ba'i dus shig nam 'ong na/ /chos gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu rnams/ /khong grub mtha' gzhan gyis tha dad 'byed/ /chos de gsum bden pa gnyis char du/ /don ngo bo dbyer med rtogs gyur na/ /dpal sa skya'i chos kyi snying po yin/ /ming 'khor 'das dbyer med ces su grags/ /gnad 'di bzhin rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mar 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras sdug kun gnyis/ /'di ma spangs lam du khyer nas ni/ /dus bskal pa'i yun la mi ltos par/ /tshegs chung ngus sangs rgyas thob par 'dug /dus deng sang mkhas pa mang na yang / /gnad 'di 'dra rtogs pa nyin skar tsam/ /khong rgyal ba'i gsung la co 'dri zhing / /mgo shin tu mkhregs pa'i rtog ge bas/ /lo du ma'i bar du brtags na yang / /khyod khyod min khyod min khyod yin zhes/ /don med pa'i chags sdang 'ur choms las/

/gnad snying po zin pa shin tu nyung / /dus snyigs ma'i skye bo gdug rtsub che/ /las ji ltar byas kyang mgu mi nus/ /da de 'dra'i ngo 'dzin byed pa las/ /rang gcig pur gnas na mi legs sam/ /yid rtse gcig sgrub la brtson nas ni/ /rang mi 'ching gzhan yang bkri nus pa'i/ /sems mi 'jigs gdeng drod rnyed pa na/ /pha khyed kyi phrin las bdag gis skyong / /de 'thad par dgongs sam skyabs kyi mchog /bu bdag gis gnas tshul ji ltar bgyi/ /pha sku drin mtshungs med khyod kyis dgongs/ /mgon khyod kyi bka' bzhin kho bos bsgrub/ /tshe 'di phyi bar do thams cad du/ /mi bdag la skyid sdug ci byung yang / /pha bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na la/ /dus rgyun du re ba bgyid pa lags/ /zhes pa'ang kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang la rtogs 'bul gyi mgur dbyangs// dge'o// ༈ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can/ /ma mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon/ /sgos sprang po bdag gi skyabs kyi mchog /pha bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmor 'dud/ /dpal ngag gi dbang phyug sa skya pa'i/ /gsung dri med gdams pa'i mdzod bzung nas/ /sprang bdag la legs par 'doms mdzad pa/ /mgon khyed kyi sku drin snying nas dran/ /lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs rnams/ /pha sku drin dbang po khyod nyid la/ /snying thag pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags na/ /thugs brtse bas bdag gir mdzad du gsol/ /rje bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhes/ /khong dad ldan kun gyis sgrog mod kyang / /skyabs thams cad bla mar 'dus pa yi/ /tshul ji bzhin rtogs pa nyung bar 'dug /bu dad ldan bdag gi blo ngo na/ /skyabs rgyal ba sku gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /mgon khyed las gzhan du ma mthong bas/ /pha chos rje rigs kyi bdag por shes/ /las ngan pa'i thag pas sbrel ba yi/ /mi mang po gcig tu 'dus pa'i sa/ /yul mdo khams smad ces bya ba 'dir/

/gnas phun sum tshogs pa rnyed dka' yang / /pha khyed kyi rjes shul bsnyeg pa'i phyir/ /dus da lta mi med lung stong du/ /phyi mi chos kyi bya ba spangs nas ni/ /rang grogs med gcig pur 'khums lags kyang / /phyi yul rkyen gyi 'tshe bas dogs pa dang / /nang rtog ngan rgyu 'grul mang ba dang / /rgyud le lo'i 'dam du bying 'dug pas/ /da myur mgyogs thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol/ /dus snyigs ma'i gnas grogs longs spyod la/ /yid zhen pa gting nas log nas ni/ /da mi tshe'i lhag ma ci yod la/ /gnas ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /gshis rig stong gnyug ma'i ye shes 'di/ /pha bla ma'i ngo bor mthong nas ni/ /dus rtag tu dran pa'i mos gus kyis/ /dbyings rang zhal mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /las nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i/ /don brtags shing dpyad na rnam rtog tsam/ /rnam rtog 'di lam du khyer shes na/ /tshogs gnyis kyang 'di yis rdzogs par 'dug /rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad ji snyed pa/ /rang sems las gzhan du mi rnyed pas/ /sems skye med stong pa'i gnad shes na/ /bar chad kyang srung ba'i 'khor lor 'char/ /bdud shes nas spong ba chos dang mthun/ /bdud rang sems su shes na lam gyi grogs/ /bdud chos nyid du mthong na lta ba'i gnad/ /bdud dngos grub tu len pa gdams ngag yin/ /skyon gtan nas med pa shin tu dkon/ /skyon yon tan du rlom na bar chad de/ /skyon spangs nas grol ba kun la yod/ /skyon yon tan du slong ba nged kyi lugs/ /skye 'chi dang bar do'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /sku gsum gyi ngo bor thag bcad nas/ /thabs zab mo lam byed bzhi ldan gyis/ /bsgom nus na sku gsum mngon du byed/ /gzhi 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras sdug kun gnyis/ /thabs smin grol lam gyis sbyangs pa las/ /dus myur du sku dang ye shes su/ /gnas gyur na 'khor 'das dbyer med yin/

/chos zab mo'i don 'di shes pa'i tshe/ /dus skad cig gcig gi nyams len la/ /lam zab mo'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ /gnad ma lus tshang ba'i nges shes skye/ /'khrul snang gi tshor ba bde sdug la/ /blang dor du zhen pa'i sred pa 'di/ /'khor ba ru 'ching byed yin mod kyang / /bde sdug la ngo bos 'ching grol med/ /'ching grol 'di blo yi 'dzin stangs te/ /zhen med kyi thabs kyis zin pa'i tshe/ /'khor ba yang lha dang ye shes su/ /'char ba zhig lam 'di'i khyad chos yin/ /rang sems 'di yan par mi 'chor bar/ /'dzin med kyi lta bas rgyas thebs na/ /bde sdug gi snang ba dpe yi ni/ /ye shes su 'char ba su yis 'gog /gnad zin na ma bsgoms kyang ye shes yin/ /blo rmongs na bsgom yang 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /ngo shes na nyon mongs ye shes te/ /gnad 'chug na lam yang 'khrul ba yin/ /myong bzhin pa'i sdug bsngal rnam rtog yin/ /rnam rtog las logs na chos nyid med/ /sdug bsngal du snang ba'i rnam rtog 'di/ /chos nyid la lta ba'i me long yin/ /sdug bsngal 'di sus kyang mi 'dod mod/ /mtha' gcig tu spang bya ma yin te/ /bde skyid kyang 'di las 'byung ba'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal 'di bde ba'i lam sa yin/ /rnam rtog las byung ba'i 'khrul snang kun/ /phyi rol du zhen na slar yang 'khrul/ /rang sems su shes nas ma bcos par/ /rang babs su zhog dang rang gsal 'char/ ༈ /blo sus kyang gzhal bar mi nus pa'i/ /rigs drug gi 'khrul snang sna tshogs 'di/ /sems rmongs pa'i pir gyis bris pa las/ /don gzhan pa'i byed pa po ni med/ /khong dus gsum 'phags tshogs thams cad kyi/ /sa lam gyi yon tan ma lus pa/ /thabs mkhas pa'i sems kyi rten 'brel las/ /kun byed pa'i byed po gzhan mi rnyed/ /rgyu des na srid zhi'i nyams 'gyur kun/ /sems rig pa'i 'char sgo tsam zhig las/ /don phyi rol na grub pa mi 'dug pas/

/chos thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /bod bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'di ru/ /sngon byon pa'i mkhas grub de dag la/ /yul snang 'di sems su bzhed pa dang / /mi bzhed pa'i lugs gnyis byung na yang / /chos rnams kyi chos nyid gcig yin pas/ /de ji bzhin gtan la 'bebs pa la/ /gnas skabs kyi brjod tshul mi mthun yang / /mthar thug gi dgongs don gcig par snang / /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi/ /rgyud zab mo 'di yi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa/ /yab sras kun snang ba sems su bzhed/ /sngags bla med rgyud kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ /tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub pa la/ /phyi snang ba sems su sgrub pa 'di/ /gnad shin tu che ba'i chos gcig yin/ /chos zab mo nang gi de nyid ni/ /lugs gzhan la zhib tu ma grags shing / /chos 'di yi zab khyad yin mod kyang / /don ji bzhin rtogs pa nyung ba 'dug /rang rtsa ba bcad na ma grub pa'i/ /sems dngos med sgyu ma'i mkhan po des/ /'khor 'das kyi snang ba ma lus pa/ /med bzhin du sprul pa ngo mtshar che/ /snang ba 'di sems su legs shes na/ /dus ring thung bzang ngan yangs dog sogs/ /'gal ba ltar snang ba mi 'gal bas/ /gnad shes na bsgom gyi grogs su 'char/ /rang snang 'di sems su ma shes na/ /bla ma la mos gus mi skyes te/ /mdzad spyod la skyon du bzung ba yis/ /dngos grub kyi skal pa chad pa mang / /dag ma dag gi snang ba rang sems las/ /phyi rol na med pa'i tshul shes na/ /skyon rang skyon du shes nas dman sa zin/ /khong gzhan la dag snang skye bar 'gyur/ /dbang thob pa'i sems dpa' mchog rnams kyi/ /mthu bsam mi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul yang / /bden med kyi snang ba rang sems su/ /ngo shes pa'i mthu las byung bar snang / /gdon log 'dren 'byung po'i cho 'phrul yang / /phyi rol du bzung na skyon yin yang / /rang snang du shes pa'i rnal 'byor par/

/bdud sde yang lam gyi grogs su 'char/ ༈ /skyabs gcig la skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus/ /chos gcig la nyams len kun tshang zhing / /gnad gcig gis sa lam bgrod nus pa/ /lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /tshul 'di ltar nyams su len pa la/ /dus dang po bla ma sangs rgyas su bsgom/ /skyabs thams cad 'dus par thag bcad nas/ /yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /bar bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /skyabs thams cad bla ma'i ngo bor shar/ /yid khyed shes kyi dad pa rgyud la skyes/ /rje bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs/ /mthar rang sems sangs rgyas rang zhal mjal/ /bla ma dang thugs yid dbyer med 'dres/ /yin lugs kyi myong ba nang nas shar/ /sgro skur gyi spros pa rang sar zhig ༈ /sems skye ba med pa zhes bya ba/ /de kha tshig tsam du ma shor bar/ /mtha' bzhi las nges par ma skyes pa'i/ /gnad legs par khong du chud pa na/ /ma skyes kyang snang ba mi 'gal zhing / /snang bzhin du ngo bos ma grub pas/ /stong rten 'byung 'gal ba med pa la/ /don yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /dus de tshe rnam thar sgo gsum gyi/ /stong nyid kyang gzugs su 'char nus shing / /gzugs des kyang snang bas mi 'ching bar/ /stong gsal la nges pa 'dren pa yin/ /gnad 'di 'dra shes na nyams len gyi/ /lam zab gsal gnyis med bskyed rim de/ /ming rkyang pa tsam du ma shor bar/ /don tshul bzhin rgyud la 'byor bar 'gyur/ /sngon rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub rjes/ /chos stong nyid seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa'i/ /don zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba ni/ /mi de yi blo la mdza' ba 'dra/ /bdag 'khor bar 'ching byed ma rig pa/ /gnyis 'dzin gyi rnam rtog yin mod kyang / /kho brtags shing dpyad na stong par yal/ /des bcing ba'i bdag kyang de bzhin rdzun/ /don de ltar spang bya ma rnyed pas/ /de spong ba'i gnyen po mi rnyed de/ /mo gsham bu'i mtshan gzhi ma grub pas/

/de gsod pa'i gshed ma mi rnyed bzhin/ /chos gang yang don la ma grub pas/ /dmigs gtad kyi mtshan ma mi rnyed kyang / /rten 'byung la slu ba med pa'i phyir/ /tha snyad du blang dor 'khor 'das yod/ /gnad 'di 'dra'i dbye ba shes gyur na/ /chos kun gyi de nyid legs shes shing / /don rtogs rgyu med pa'i don rtogs pas/ /sems grol rgyu med pa grol zhes gsungs/ /nyon mongs 'di rang dgar spyad na phung / /'di spang na ye shes kyi rgyu mi rnyed/ /thabs mkhas pas bsten na nyon mongs nyid/ /ye shes su shes nas grol bar 'gyur/ /'khrul snang 'di don dam ma yin te/ /don dam yang de las gzhan na med/ /gnad shes na chu dang chab rom bzhin/ /de gnyis kyang 'gal ba med pa yin/ /phung po la zhen na bdud yin te/ /'di spangs na zhi ba'i mtha' ru lhung / /chos zab mo dag pa rnam gsum gyis/ /sbyang nus na myur du sangs rgyas thob/ /sdug bsngal la skrag nas spong ba dang / /dga' bzhin du dang du len pa dang / /bden med du shes nas brten pa yi/ /gnad gsum gyis sdug bsngal lam du byed/ /dus da lta'i 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal 'di/ /ngo shes na bde chen ye shes te/ /blo dgag sgrub spros pa mi mang bar/ /sems ma bcos par zhog dang gnad 'gag yin/ /phyi snang ba sems kyi sprul par shes/ /sems yul la zhen pa'i 'khri ba chod/ /yul gang shar la dgag sgrub mi 'chor bar/ /blo re dogs dang bral na dga' ba la/ /skyon thams cad kyi rtsa ba zhen pa ste/ /mar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal nas/ /sa lam gyi bar chad thams cad kyang / /'dzin zhen kyi rtog pa 'di las byung / /blo zhen med kyi dge ba sgrub shes na/ /dge legs kun 'du bar smos ci dgos/ /skyabs mthar thug thub pa'i chos sku yang / /blo zhen med kyi ngang du 'du bar 'dug /sgos tshe 'dir zhen pa'i rtog ngan 'dis/ /blo chos su 'gro ru ma bcug par/

/mi bdag ni de snga yan chod phung / /grogs gzhan yang 'di yis phung bar 'dug ༈ /dus grangs med gsum gyi tshogs gnyis kyang / /gzhi rang gi sems snang 'di nyid yin/ /sku bzhi dang ye shes rnam lnga yang / /sems 'di las gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur/ /chos gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med de/ /thabs zab mo sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi/ /lam shin tu gsang ba'i nye lam 'dis/ /sangs rgyas zhes smra ba mi ring nye/ /gnad 'di dag bsgoms pa'i blo gros kyi/ /nyams myong zhig bdag la ma mchis kyang / /mos gus kyis gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /go yul du bla ma'i drin gyis yin/ ༈ /da tshe mjug gi bde skyid 'byung re bas/ /mi gzhan gyi ngo srung mthun 'jug gi/ /re dogs kyi ngal khur len pa yi/ /sdig sdug gi rtsa ba bor nas ni/ /gnas mi med dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /grogs bya dang nags tshal dang 'grogs nas/ /chos byang chub sems la blo sbyangs nas/ /shi thub na skyid pa'i yang rtse lags/ ༈ /'khor ba 'di spang byar grags mod kyang / /rang snang 'di lha dang ye shes su/ /ngo shes tshe spang bya mi rnyed pas/ /don 'khor 'das ngo bo dbyer med yin/ /bar chad 'di med na dga' lags kyang / /'di med na dngos grub mi thob pas/ /thabs mkhas pas lam du khyer shes na/ /dngos grub kyi mtshams sbyor bar chad yin/ /phyi yul rkyen ngan pa med sa med/ /'di gnyen pos spang du mi lang gi/ /gnad shes nas lam du khyer nus na/ /rkyen ngan 'di dge sbyor gyi bskul ma yin/ /sems 'khrul pa'i dbang du gyur pa la/ /phyi yul snang dgra ru ldang mod kyang / /nang yin lugs shes pa'i rnal 'byor par/ /'di thams cad dge ba'i bshes su 'char/ /'khor ba la nges 'byung nas bzung ste/ /mthar thug gi sku dang ye shes sogs/ /lam 'bras kyi yon tan ma lus pa/ /sems rig thog gcig tu dril nas ni/ /gnad tshang bar nyams su len pa 'di/

/khong sa skya'i 'jam mgon rin po che'i/ /bka' srol 'di'i zab khyad yin pa'i phyir/ /gnad shes na snying nas yid ches skye/ /sdug bsngal kun 'di las byung ba'i phyir/ /rnam rtog 'di skyon gyi gong bu yin/ /gnas lugs kyang 'di las rnyed pa'i phyir/ /yon tan yang 'di rang che bar 'dug /'khrul snang 'di rnam rtog las byung yang / /'di med na gnas lugs mi rnyed de/ /rnam rtog gi ngo bo skyong shes na/ /chos nyid la lta ba'i me long yin/ /rnam rtog 'di chos nyid ma yin kyang / /chos nyid las gzhan pa'i rnam rtog med/ /ngo shes na 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog 'di/ /dbyings chos sku'i rang zhal mjal ba yin/ /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /rgyal sras kun gshegs pa'i lam bzang po/ /chos kun gyi snying po byang chub sems/ /'di rgyud la skyes na ci ma rung / /khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman/ /srid zhi yi dge legs kun gyi rgyu/ /chos byang chub sems kyi nor bu mchog /'di don du gnyer na sus kyang rnyed/ /gang snang ba chos nyid las mi g.yo bas/ /gshis gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor par/ /skyon gzhan nas btsal yang mi rnyed pa'i/ /dus de 'dra 'byung zhes bla mas gsungs/ /phyi yul snang sems kyi sprul par shes/ /sems yul la zhen pa'i 'khri ba chod/ /yul gang shar la dgag sgrub mi 'chor bar/ /blo re dogs dang bral na dga' ba la/ /chos rim gnyis lhan du bsgom pa'i tshe/ /gzhi bden gnyis gtan la 'bebs pa dang / /lam tshogs gnyis shugs kyis rdzogs pa zhig /dus gcig la byung na dga' ba la/ /mnyam nyid kyi lta ba klong du gyur/ /spang thob kyi re dogs nang nas zhig /mnyam nyid las nam yang mi g.yo ba'i/ /skal bzang zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /gnas skabs kyi las bzhi'i dngos grub kyang / /rang sems las gzhan du ma mchis te/ /sems 'khrul rtog zhig na yon tan rgyas/

/'di dbang du 'dus na dgra bgegs thul/ /don mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub kyang / /gzhan gang du btsal yang mi rnyed de/ /sems 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa la/ /sangs rgyas zhes ming du btags par zad/ /sems mya ngan drag pos non pa'am/ /chags sdang gi rtog pa skyes pa'i tshe/ /shar bzhin pa'i dus na rang bzhin gyi/ /ma skyes par shes pa gnad du che/ /sems 'tshub tshe yod yod 'dra na yang / /'di bzhag na rdzun pa'i rang mtshang ngom/ /don de phyir 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems/ /'di glod na grol zhes gsung bar 'dug /bde sdug 'di phyi ru bzung nas ni/ /rtsol sgrub kyis rang sdug nyo ba las/ /dge sdig 'di sems su ngo shes nas/ /bde skyid 'di sems la btsal na dga'/ /pha mtshan ldan bla mas rjes bzung nas/ /chos mdo rgyud gnyis kyi bcud bsdus pa/ /lam gsung ngag 'di dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /da ma yengs ma yengs snyoms las can/ /skyabs mtshan ldan bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /lam gsang chen rim gnyis zab mo'i don/ /dus rgyun chad med par nyams su longs/ /da shi yang 'gyod pa med par gyis/ /skyabs dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma rje'i/ /thugs dmigs pa med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dus da lta nyid du byin brlabs nas/ /bu bdag gi re smon 'grub par mdzod/ /ces kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis gang dran smras pa'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yi ngo bo/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag tu bzhugs pa/ /smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bka' drin gyis skyong ba'i/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma snying dbus nas dran no/ /zol med gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis rgyang ring nas 'bod na/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis dgyes bzhin du 'tsho zhing / /dmigs med thugs rje chen pos bdag sogs kyi rgyud la/ /dgongs pa'i byin chen phob cig drin chen gyi bla ma/ dpal ldan sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rgyal kun gyi ngo bo/

/lung rtogs dam chos 'byung gnas theg gsum gyi lam ston/ /gsum ldan dge 'dun bye ba'i gtsug rgyan du bzhugs pa'i/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum 'dus bla ma de mkhyen no/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod las byung ba'i/ /sngon byon grub brgya'i gshegs shul gsang chen gyi myur lam/ /blo dang brtson pa'i stobs kyis bde blag tu bgrod pa'i/ /mtshungs med grub pa'i dbang phyug bla ma de mkhyen no/ /dgongs pa sangs rgyas rnams dang dbyer med du bzhugs kyang / /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i snang ngor mi gzugs su byon nas/ /las smon mthun pa'i skal ldan gdul bya yi tshogs la/ /rnam grol lam bzang ston pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi dgyes bzhin du bstsal ba/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i snyim pas tshul bzhin du myangs nas/ /lung rtogs yon tan chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang ba'i/ /dga' ston nyams su myong ba'i byin rlabs shig zhu'o/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba rgyang ring du spangs nas/ /yid mthun dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa la gzhol zhing / /myur du zab lam rtogs pa'i drod tshad dang 'phrad nas/ /bla ma'i 'phrin las skyong ba'i skal bzang la smon no/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun rang sems su thag chad/ /gnyug ma sems kyi chos nyid mngon sum du mthong nas/ /rang sems bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i/ /'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /mtshan rtog 'khrul pa'i snang ba sprin bzhin du yal nas/ /snod bcud dag pa lha yi dkyil 'khor du shar ba/ /de yang bde ba chen po'i ye shes su mthong ba'i/ /myur du grub mtha' snyogs pa'i dngos grub zhig zhu'o/ /bde 'byung bstan pa'i nyi ma nub ri la 'dzegs te/ /cher snyigs rgud pa'i mun pa phyogs kun tu khyab tshe/ /phrin las bsil zer bye ba'i dpal yon dang 'grogs pa'i/

/rje btsun smra ba'i zla ba'i 'od dkar 'di byung ngo / /dpal ldan mtshan mo'i mgon khyod mngon sum du mjal nas/ /legs bshad gsung gi snang ba snying dbus su shar bas/ /yun ring sems la nyal ba'i rmongs pa yi mun pa/ /de ring bla ma'i drin gyis ga shed la langs song / /mtshungs med bla ma'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du rtogs nas/ /sa bstan nyin mor byed pa'i skal bzang la smon pa/ /rkyen ngan yul gyi 'tshe ba gang nas kyang 'byung bas/ /bar chad bdud las rgyal ba'i byin rlabs shig gnang shog /gangs ljongs skal ldan gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi zhing mkhar/ /bla ma'i nyin byed dkyil 'khor yun ring du gnas shing / /phun tshogs phan bde'i pad tshal phyogs kun tu rgyas pa'i/ /dge mtshan nub pa med pa'i smon 'dun zhig zhu'o/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i ring lugs/ /kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po'i bka' srol las byung ba/ /rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len gyi rgyun 'di/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa la smon no/ /ji ltar smon pa'i gnas kun gegs med du 'grub pa'i/ /mthun 'gyur sras bcas rgyal bas bden gsung gis sgrogs shing / /dmigs med thugs rje'i spyan gyis rjes 'jug la gzigs pa'i/ /dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis rang rlobs shig /ces pa 'di ni yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po thar rtse mkhan rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun bzang thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang rin chen gnyis pa'i skyes bcas bka' bstsal ba spyi bor gus pas blangs te/ rje nyid kyi bka' 'bangs su gtogs pa yul li thang phyogs su skyes pa'i btsun gzugs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis dga' ldan sa bzang gling du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ shubhaṃ// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /sdom gsum bka' drin stsol ba'i drin chen rje/

/skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /thog med dus nas srid par 'khyams na yang / /rang gi nyes pas da dung 'khor bar lus/ /da res 'khrul snang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal la/ /'jigs nas chos la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dod lnga'i yul gyi bde ba'i bslu khrid 'dis/ /rang gzhan thams cad bslus par mthong nas ni/ /'khrul snang tshe 'di'i bde la mi chags par/ /lha chos snying nas dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /ji ltar byas kyang mgu bar mi nus pa'i/ /gzhan gyi ngo srung thag pa bcad nas ni/ /gang la bsten na nam yang mi bslu ba'i/ /bla ma mchog gsum dran par༞ /yon tan med bzhin bla ma'i khur 'dzin pa/ /skyabs su bzung yang phan pa 'byung dka' bas/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin 'jam mgon bla ma la/ /sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bar༞ /sdig pas sbags pa'i rang gi 'khrul rtog 'dis/ /gzhan gyi yon tan mthong bar mi nus pas/ /bla ma'i mdzad pa ji ltar bstan na yang / /yon tan 'ba' zhig mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lan cig rnyed dka'i dal ba'i rten bzang 'di/ /yengs ma lam du mi tshe zad 'dug pas/ /dgung nyi tsam gyi tshe 'jug 'di nyid la/ /rnam dag lha chos 'grub par༞ snying nas chos la 'jug 'dod skyes pa na/ /bar chad nyi rdul las kyang ches mang bas/ /bla ma mchog gsum lha yi byin mthu yis/ /skyen ngan g.yul las rgyal bar༞ /'grub dus med pa'i tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la/ /snying po med pa'i ngang tshul 'di mthong nas/ /'grub par nges pa bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /sgrub la snying rus nus par༞ /sangs rgyas dngos 'dra'i bla ma 'di 'dra ba/ /sngon gyi dus na'ang mjal bar dka' bas na/ /mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na la/ /nyams len gnad du 'khel bar༞ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i skad cig la/ /'khrul snang sdug bsngal sprin bzhin yal nas ni/ /da lta shi yang 'gyod pa med snyam pa'i/

/dga' bde snying la 'char bar༞ /slan chad bdag gi spyod pa ma lus pa/ /dpal mgon bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod sprin du/ /gyur nas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa yi/ /phan bde'i dga' ston 'phel bar༞ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma rin po ches/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung nas ni/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan kun rdzogs nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di ni snying nas brtse ba'i grogs mchog dam pa tshe rabs gzhan du'ang 'phrad par nges pa bkra shis chos ldan dang / gnyer ngag dbang rin chen gnyis kyi bzhed skong du/ mang du thos pa'i bla gzugs yul li thang phyogs su skyes pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mgyogs par smras pa'o// sarba dā maṅgalaṃ// //dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /bdud 'dul mthu chen rdo rje nag po che/ /deng 'dir bdag gi mgon gcig chos kyi rje/ /ngag dbang legs pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la/ /skyon du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mi skye zhing / /ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ /byin rlabs sems la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma mchog gsum lha yi byin mthu dang / /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan pa dang / /'phrin las dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /mos gus thob pa'i slob ma yis/ /sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /rgyal ba gsum par bris pa dge/ ༈ /oṃ swasti/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsang gsum byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /gang thugs blo yi bum pa bzang por ma nyams legs par bskyil mdzad pa/ /mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i bcud ldan gsang chen chos kyi a mṛ tas/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i dga' ston spel mkhas dpal ldan bla mas bdag skyongs shig

༈ /rin po che gdan 'dren zhu yig bzhugs/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs bla ma yi/ /gsang gsum byin rlabs snying la legs zhugs pas/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i gter mdzod gcig gyur pa/ /chos kyi spyan ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /mi phyed dad pa'i chu las skyes pa yi/ /zhu mchid me tog gsar pa'i chun po 'di/ /snying nas gus pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags na/ /dgyes pa'i spyan ras g.yo bar mdzad du gsol/ /da lta rin po che sku khams bzang zhing bcad rgya grol nas skal pa dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la smin grol gyi chos 'khor bskor bzhin du bzhugs yod las che snyam pa tsam las skad cha ci yang ma tshor/ 'dir yang mchog gsum byin mthus gnas skabs nyer 'tshes dben zhing ltar snang la bsnyen mtshams lta bur 'khum lags/ mtshams zhu/ na ning zla 'od nged gnyis der mdun na 'ong skabs zhal mjal gsung thos kyi skal pas dben rung / 'byung 'gyur la rjes su 'dzin rgyu'i gsung phrin gnang ba la'ang dbyar rnga thos pa'i rma bya bzhin du dga' spro phul du phyin pa byung lags/ da dgos snying por dril ba'i zhu ba ni/ bdag gis de snga 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang blo gter dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i zhal mjal gsung thos kyi skal bzang byung rung / cung zad thos pa rnams kyang go yul du lus/ skyes sbyang gi blo gros dman zhing / nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pas nyams len sna gcig byas pa ni med pas/ da chos med du 'chir dogs pas bla ma zhig bsten par 'dod kyang / 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang ni ma bzhugs/ gzhan 'di phyogs na rang lugs kyi smin grol gyi gdams pa zhu 'os su'ang mi mchis te/ dam tshig gso ba'i dbang tsam zhu ba'i yul yang mi rnyed par 'dug chos kyi rje khyed kyi rnam thar la kha tsam min par snying nas dad pa thob cing / bdag gi khu bo chos kyi spyan ldan de dang /

nyid rin po che rnam gnyis bla slob tu gyur cing thugs nang shin tu gtsang ba'i stobs kyis de'i dam tshig la dgongs nas brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i re ba zhig bdog des na mgon po khyed nyid 'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs gnas su bzung nas/ mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten cing bka' bzhin bsgrubs te dal 'byor don yod zhig byung na snyam pa kha tsam ma lags so/ /gzhan 'di phyogs na blo gros gsal ba don gnyer can re gnyis yod rung / dbang lung khrid gsum gsung mkhan su yang ma byung bas/ lam dus tsam kha ton du byed pa nyin skar tsam du zad pas des na long ba bshes med thang stong du 'khyam pa lta bu bdag cag thugs kyis mi 'dor bar zhu zhu/ yos lo zla ba bzhi ba'i nang tsam la sde dge phyogs su 'byon thub pa zhig lan brgyar gsol ba 'debs na/ dus la babs par dgongs te cis kyang bka' drin skyong thub pa zhu zhu/ 'on te sde dge phyogs su 'byon stabs ma bde na/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang tsam la sel shul dgon du 'byon thub pa zhig mdzad rogs dang / nged rnams der chibs bsur bsleb 'ong lags/ gal te smad phyogs 'dir gtan nas 'byon pa'i skal pa ma byung tshe mgon khyed gang du bzhugs pa der nga rang bsleb 'ong nges lags pas/ de lugs gsung phrin zhig stsol thub par zhu zhu/ 'dir smras pa/ sku mchog pad dkar mig gis ma mthong yang / /grags snyan bsung zhim thos pa'i mod nyid na/ /zab don sbrang rtsi'i ro la chags pa yi/ /gus ldan bung bas mgrin rnga cir yang 'khrol/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /tshogs gnyis yal ga rgyas pa'i ljon bzang khyod/ /bsten na grub gnyis ro brgya'i bcud ldan pa'i/ /dpag yas yon tan 'bras bu phyug ces thos/ /rmad byung brtson pa'i ded dpon gyis blangs pa'i/ /lung rtogs yon tan rin chen bye ba'i gter/ /gang blo mdzod kyi nor du sprod pa'i phyir/

/rgyal ba'i sras khyod 'gro ba'i sbyin bdag lags/ /gang zhig bslab gsum nor gyis dbul gyur cing / /sna tshogs nyon mongs duḥkhas rab tu gdung / /chos med sprang po'i nang du 'khyam pa yi/ /phongs pa bdag ni slong mo ba dang mtshungs/ /de slad gdugs kyis gdung ba'i glang po dag /pad ma'i mtsho la dga' bas 'jug pa ltar/ /rmongs shing som nyi'i mun par 'phyan pa yi/ /blun po bdag ni khyod zhabs bsten la spro/ /dang por mgon khyod bsten cing bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ /de nas yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas shig tu/ /rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i skal bzang zhig /nam zhig 'byung zhes bdag ni yang yang sems/ /de gcig ma lags bdag gi chos kyi grogs/ /smra ba'i zla ba legs bshad 'od dkar can/ /des kyang skom pa'i gdung bas chu bzhin du/ /mgon khyod yang yang yid la sems shing mchis/ /'jigs rung bdud sde'i smag rum 'joms pa yi/ /gang thugs mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor 'od brgya pas/ /nyam chung bdag blo'i chu skyes mi skyong na/ /phongs pa bdag gis skyabs gnas su la zhu/ /mgon med dgon par 'khyam pa'i skye bo bzhin/ /legs lam ston pa'i bshes dang bral ba yi/ /nyam thag bdag cag thugs rjes mi 'dor bar/ /re ba skong bar mdzod cig chos kyi rje/ /sku mchog pad dkar mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ /gsung snyan rnga sgras rna ba'i dpal bskyed cing / /thugs rje'i zer gyis blo yi mun 'joms pa'i/ /dus de bdag la ring bar ma gyur cig /cher snyigs rgud pa'i dus 'dir skyes gyur nas/ /mi 'dod sna dgus gdung ba bdag cag la/ /rjes su brtse bas mdo smad ljongs 'di ru/ /cis kyang 'byon par mdzod cig chos kyi rje/ /gcig tu mchog gsum lha yi byin mthu dang / /gnyis su chos rje khyed kyi thugs bskyed dang / /gsum du dam can srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis/ /ji ltar smon pa thog tu khel gyur cig/

༈ /gsol 'debs dngos grub mchog stsol bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rnam dag spyod pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad sku ni rgyal ba'i sprul pa'i sku/ /zab rgyas chos la rdzogs par longs spyod dri med gsung ni longs spyod rdzogs/ /'khrul ba'i dri mas gzhar yang ma gos gnyis med chos sku'i thugs mnga' ba/ /sku gsum dbyer med bla ma mchog la sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i chu gter 'phel byed sku yi zla ba rgyal ba'i sras/ /gdul bya'i nyon mongs tsha gdung 'gog pa'i gsung gi bsil zer dam pa'i chos/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa drung nas 'byin pa'i thugs kyi nyin byed sangs rgyas te/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma'i zhabs pad byang chub bar du spyi bos mchod/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes pha mtha' bral ba ji snyed shes bya'i rjes su 'gro/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje phyogs su ma lhung ris med 'gro ba'i grangs dang mnyam/ /nus pa'i phrin las thogs pa med pas dpag dka'i 'khor ba'i mtha' bsnyil ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus bla ma'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la gnas sku yi spyod pa rnam par dag /gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi'i mdzod 'chang gsung gi 'phrin las 'gro ba sdud/ /chos nyid bden pa mngon sum gzigs pas dgongs pa sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma'i yon tan yid la dran pas snyim pa'i chu skyes spyi bor zum/ /sku yi snang brnyan mthong ba yis kyang dad pa'i chu gter 'phel bar byed/ /gsung gi sgra dbyangs thos pa'i mod la thar pa'i sa bon 'debs byed cing / /thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs pas srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun sel ba/ /phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal pos byang chub bar du bskyang du gsol/ /lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus blo yis yongs bsdus nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas gus pa yis/

/chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan bla ma dwang ba'i yid kyis rtag mchod na/ /dmigs med thugs rjes 'bral ba med par bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ sna tshogs las ngan khur gyis non cing dad brtson blo yi lus stobs zhan/ /glo bur skyen ngan rlung gis ded cing mgon med nyam thag gyur pa bdag /brtse chen thugs rje'i phyag gis drangs nas rnam grol bde ba'i khang bzang du/ /ngal bso'i dbugs 'byin myur du mdzod cig 'jam mgon bla ma chos kyi rje/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal sems kyi sa gzhir gzhan phan sems kyi sa bon btab/ /nges 'byung snying rje'i rlan gyis bskyed bsring thabs mkhas zhing pas legs bsrungs zhing / /rnam dag lta ba'i snye ma dud cing rnam mang yon tan 'bras bu phyug /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor 'gyur ba'i dngos grub bdag la bstsal du gsol/ /smin byed bdud rtsi'i zas kyis 'tsho zhing bskyed rdzogs lang tsho'i dpal 'bar zhing / /gnyis med spyod pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing he ru ka dpal bla ma rje/ gshegs pa'i lam bzang myur du bgrod de 'gyur med rtogs pa'i gdeng drod kyis/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral mthong ba'i skal bzang de yang myong bar mdzod/ /tshogs gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las 'ong gang sku'i dkyil 'khor padmo'i gnyen/ /rmad byung thugs bskyed shing rtas drangs shing gdul bya'i bsod nams zhing gi mkhar/ /dam chos gsung gi tsha zer 'gyed bzhin da dung bskal pa gnas kyi bar/ /mi nub rtag brtan gzi byin 'bar bzhin bkra shis snang ba brtan par shog /bla ma'i thugs rjes 'gro rgyud 'dzin mar mi mthun dgun gyi reg bsal nas/ /mos gus dpyid kyi ma mas legs bskyangs gnas skabs dbyar gyi phun tshogs dang / /mthar thug rnam grol ston gyi 'bras bzang g.yur du za ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /skye rgu rgya mtsho'i phan bde'i dga' ston mchog tu 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni gzo rig 'phrul las byung ba'i rje bla ma'i snang brnyan ngo mtshar ba mjal bas mos gus kyi rkyen byas te sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi mgon po'i dus chen gyi snga dro'i char rje nyid kyi slob 'bangs mos gus dang ldan pa kun dga'i ming can gyis bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// ༈ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dgongs pa thugs su chud/ /rgyal bas lung bstan kun dga' bzang po yi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yun du 'dzin mdzad pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus dpal mgon bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /dus gsum rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe rab kun tu mtshan ldan bla ma yis/ /brtse chen thugs kyis rjes su bzung nas ni/ /srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag las/ /mgon po khyed kyis skyob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni gnyer bkra shis chos ldan gyi bzhed skong du kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa dge'o// ༈ /rang blo yang dag chos dang ma 'dres par/ /ltar snang gzhan don sgrub pa'i rnam g.yeng gis/ /gzhan dbang 'du 'dzi'i g.yang la bskyur mthong nas/ /blo sna btsan chod nus༞ /mi med dben pa'i ri sul nyams dga' bar/ /dgos med tshe 'di'i bya ba kun spangs nas/ /long med 'chi ba dran pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /'jigs med btsan sa zin par༞ /mtshan ldan bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /zab lam gdams pa snying gi bcud du khug /nyams len sgrub la brtson pa'i lcags kyis bskul/ /lam rtags yon tan rnyed par༞ /rje btsun bla ma dran pa'i skad cig la/ /sku gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams/ /de las gzhan du med par thag chod nas/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'gyur bar༞ /ma dag 'khrul snang bden med sgyu mar mthong / /nyams myong ting 'dzin zhen med rgyan du shar/

/dag pa rab 'byams rgyal ba'i chos kyi sku/ /ye shes mig gis mthong bar༞ /mgon khyod skyabs su brnyed pa'i bka' drin gyis/ /'gyod bzhin 'chi ba'i shul lam mi bsnyeg par/ /rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rjes mdun bsus te/ /dag pa'i zhing du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ ༈ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje sprul pa'i gar/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i srung ma drag shul can/ /dpal ldan mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas kyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon dang grogs mdzod cig ༈ /lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang / /ki la rigs bzhi khro bcu yab yum dang / /za gsod nyi shu sgo ma bzhi dang bcas/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dkar mo nyi zla srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal/ /phur srung mthu chen bdag nyid ma bzhi dang / /shwa na ma bzhi sa bdag ma bzhi bcas/ /dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 18 sde ston a 'jam/ bla ma rgyang 'bod dang gsol 'debs skor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
